reason: Microsoft deprecated the bare legacy ms-screenclip: app-integration entry, while a live Windows 11 Explorer-handled Win+Shift+S observation showed the actual Snipping Tool command ms-screenclip:///?source=HotKey.
correction: Use the exact observed OS-hotkey URI and explicitly exclude the packaged capture/callback protocol.

follow_up.reason: Explorer-free headful run proved ShellExecute returned success without creating SnipOverlayRootWindow.
follow_up.correction: Use documented IApplicationActivationManager::ActivateForProtocol with the fixed Microsoft ScreenSketch AUMID and observed native-hotkey URI.

test_lifecycle_refinement.reason: The generic --shell product path mutates Winlogon and arms recovery, which is inappropriate for a bounded physical shortcut fixture.
test_lifecycle_refinement.correction: Add a verification-only entry that retains session/owner admission and real hook/surface code while skipping registry, guardian, and UAC mutation. The harness remains responsible for Explorer suppression and recovery.

activation_thread_refinement.reason: Explorer-free trace proved ActivateForProtocol can wait while the packaged overlay consumes activation arguments.
activation_thread_refinement.correction: Run one named COM worker per fenced physical press; observe and dismiss the overlay before requiring the accepted trace.

activation_contract_correction.reason: ActivateForProtocol returned 0x80270254 because Snipping Tool does not declare the observed hotkey URI as a Windows.Protocol extension.
activation_contract_correction.correction: Use IApplicationActivationManager::ActivateApplication with the observed fixed AUMID, fixed hotkey argument, and AO_NONE.

temporary_broker_correction.authority: User explicitly directed autonomous decisions and native Windows parity without further confirmation.
temporary_broker_correction.reason: Windows 11 build 26200 produced no SnipOverlayRootWindow with Explorer absent through ShellExecute, direct /clip, ActivateForProtocol, or ActivateApplication. The overlay also disappears if Explorer is terminated while it is open.
temporary_broker_correction.correction: Start only signed canonical inbox Explorer when absent, retain it only while SnipOverlayRootWindow exists, then terminate through current-session/canonical-path validation. Never close a pre-existing Explorer as request-owned.
